dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical reduction in width starting from the mid-thorax and narrowing sharply toward the visible posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: A subtle outward protrusion is visible on the left mid-lateral margin; the right margin exhibits a more linear and consistent inward curvature.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to off-white; high-intensity reflectance across the primary dorsal field with subtle darkening toward the submerged lateral edges.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker-grey shading concentrated along the lower lateral margins; minimal dorsal mottling is visible.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transition between the lighter dorsal canvas and the slightly darker lateral pigmentation.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Small, high-contrast white linear mark located approximately one blowhole-width posterior and slightly left of the blowhole center.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Clearly defined blowhole cavity; sharp, linear dorsal ridge along the posterior section creates a distinct longitudinal highlight.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a minor white epidermal scratch posterior to the blowhole.
